page_title: BUR 1-1 WOL | Burnley v Wolves 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Yerson Mosquera (Wolves) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Andrew Kitchen lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+4' Ashley Barnes (Burnley) was probably a bit loose with his words to Andrew Kitchen, who decides to show him a yellow.
90+1' Burnley earn a corner.
90+1' It will be a corner kick for Burnley.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' The ball goes out for a corner. Burnley can continue in their attacking effort.
90' Lucas Pires (Burnley) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
88' Mateus Mane (Wolves) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
87' Burnley seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is coming onto the pitch as Jaidon Anthony cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' It is time for a substitution. Ashley Barnes (Burnley) is on for Zian Flemming.
82' The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Rodrigo Gomes is replaced by Pedro Lima (Wolves).
81' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
80' The percentage of ball possession is – 69:31.
77' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
77' The ball is crossed into the box and Lucas Pires (Burnley) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Jose Sa gets a glove on it to thwart him.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marcus Edwards (Burnley) for Loum Tchaouna.
75' Here is a change. Lesley Ugochukwu is going off and Mike Jackson gives the last tactical orders to James Ward-Prowse (Burnley).
74' Substitution. Jerome Abbey (Wolves) in, Adam Armstrong out.
74' Rob Edwards has decided to substitute David Moller Wolfe and he is replaced by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
72' Burnley are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
70' A cooling break is underway.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toluwalase Emmanuel Arokodare (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Angel Gomes.
66' Mike Jackson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) replacing Hannibal Mejbri.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ladislav Krejci departs the field of play to be replaced by Toti (Wolves).
66' The attendance for today's match is 21057.
65' Wolves get a free kick.
64' So close! Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
63' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
62' Mateus Mane (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but Max Weiss punches the ball away.
61' Lovely run from Lucas Pires (Burnley). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
58' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrew Kitchen blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Florentino (Burnley) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
52' Mateus Mane (Wolves) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
47' 1 - 1 Zian Flemming (Burnley) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
45+9' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+7' Close! Florentino (Burnley) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
45+4' The game is interrupted now, Ladislav Krejci (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+3' Now Wolves have a corner.
45+2' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Jose Sa gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
45+1' The ball is out of play. Burnley will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+1' A cross from Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
41' Today's referee Andrew Kitchen rightly decides to book Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) for his harsh tackle.
39' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' The ball goes out of play and Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
37' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Loum Tchaouna (Burnley).
35' Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
35' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
32' The ball goes out of play. Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
29' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' Axel Tuanzebe (Burnley) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' Andrew Kitchen blows for a foul after Santiago Bueno (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
21' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
18' Burnley are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' The game is interrupted. Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
13' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) tries to find Kyle Walker, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
11' The linesman points to the corner flag, Burnley are going to take it.
10' POST! Mateus Mane (Wolves) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
10' A free kick to Burnley.
9' Andre (Wolves) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andrew Kitchen blows for a foul.
5' 0 - 1 Goal! Adam Armstrong (Wolves) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Max Weiss to commit before slotting the penalty into the roof of the net.
5' Adam Armstrong (Wolves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
4' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Wolves!
4' There's a break in play and referee Andrew Kitchen must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Wolves using VAR. This could be interesting!
3' Surely that's handball by one of the Burnley players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
3' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolves.
2' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Wolves will take a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
Wolves will kick-off.
Andrew Kitchen will supervise the game today.
